crew.overview: The peaceful life of a gas station owner is disrupted when a man from his past arrives in town and forces him to return to the dark world he had tried to escape.
crew.title: Out of the Past

details.biography: Boyd Cabeen was born on March 14, 1921 in Lincoln, Nebraska, USA as Charles Boyd Cabeen. He is known for his work on Desire Me (1947) and Gentlemen Marry Brunettes (1955). He was married to Irene "Jean" Marin and Carmen Cabeen. He died on September 11, 1984 in Los Angeles County, California, USA.
details.name: Boyd Cabeen
